piezas.titulo: Reading words: Places and basic directions
texto: Reading and spelling of signs: «ห้องน้ำ» combines «ห้อง» (high-class consonant ห with the sign ้, falling tone) and «น้ำ» (low-class consonant น with the sign ้, high tone). «ตรงไป» has the consonant cluster tr (ตร) in mid tone and the vowel ไ in front of ป (mid tone). In «ซ้าย» (left), the low-class consonant ซ carries the mark ้, which gives a clear high tone. Recognising these characters is essential for reading signs at airports, shopping centres and stations.
